recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the missed semantic part of FHIR-32985 while respecting FHIR-40416's later cardinality change; no further core source action is indicated beyond normal generated artifact refresh during the build.
issue_request: FHIR-32985 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It requested removing location from MeasureReport.reporter, adding a first-class MeasureReport.location element that can reference a Location or Organization representing where the report is from, and adding a public health indicator example sent from multiple locations.
initial_application: Commit 692a0961542b67f199286eb41cd512ee69ade637 added MeasureReport.location and removed Location from MeasureReport.reporter, and commit af54eae034891419e6713e7ed99a72d67b666569 added the MeasureReport-location search parameter. That application left the new element Location-only and did not populate the public health HIV indicators example with location references.
additional_context: MeasureReport is active in source/fhir.ini. Later applied issue FHIR-40416 changed MeasureReport.location cardinality from 0..1 to 0..*, and Zulip implementer consultation did not reveal objections, so this reconciliation retained 0..* rather than reverting to FHIR-32985's original cardinality. No direct FHIR-32985 Zulip or Confluence conflict was found.
reconciliation: Updated the active MeasureReport StructureDefinition so MeasureReport.location can reference Location or Organization, updated the corresponding search parameter description and targets, and added two contained Location resources plus repeated location references to the listed HIV indicators public health MeasureReport example. The generated-looking SVG was not hand-edited; authoritative XML now carries the corrected semantics for regeneration.
source_changes: source/measurereport/structuredefinition-MeasureReport.xml: updated MeasureReport.location definition and added Organization as an allowed targetProfile while keeping max 0..*.
source/measurereport/bundle-MeasureReport-search-params.xml: updated MeasureReport-location description and declared Location and Organization search targets.
source/measurereport/measurereport-hiv-indicators.xml: added two contained Location resources and repeated location references to the public health indicator example.
